Why NAUB Home Finder

Built Different, For Your Safety

We go beyond a simple listing board. Every feature is designed to protect NAUB students from fraud and bad landlords.

Escrow Payment Protection

Your rent is held securely until you physically confirm you have moved in. No landlord receives a kobo before you are settled.

Trust Score System

Every landlord and student earns a verified trust score based on identity checks, completed transactions, and peer ratings.

GPS Occupancy Verification

Share your location and enter your unique 6-character code on move-in day to confirm occupancy and release funds.

How It Works

From search to settled, a clear and safe process for every student.

01

Create Your Account

Register as a student, landlord, or agent. Upload your ID to get verified and build your trust score.

02

Browse and Shortlist

Filter by price, rooms, location, and trust rating. Every listing is reviewed before going live.

03

Book and Pay Safely

Send a booking request. Rent goes into escrow, secure until you are in your new home.

04

Move In and Confirm

Use your occupancy code and GPS to confirm move-in. Funds release to the landlord automatically.
